messages:
mari (product): Need a compact rollout plan for TenantPriority v0. Customers want opt-in pilots, rollback windows, and clear metric gates. Can we agree on slices + A/B measurement now?

diego (eng): Proposal: three slices - internal dogfood, opt-in pilots (region-tagged), and 10% random tenants. Slow-start per-tenant for the first 6 hours.

zara (sre): Safety checklist: global kill switch, per-tenant token cap, and automated exclusion of noisy tenants from evaluation. Require route-back to legacy within 60s.

lee (eng-ml): For quality, run paired A/B (same prompt to v0 and v1) for 24h on 5% of traffic. Metrics: embedding sim, content-divergence, and p95 latency delta. Auto-promote tenant to fp if quantized drops below threshold.

amy (sales): Two customers (atlas-eu, climber) asked to pilot but need a 4h rollback SLA and a weekly review. Can we promise that?

rachel (cs): We'll collect subjective feedback via a short form linked to request ids. Also require a KB explaining expected small regressions during pilot.

mari (product): Draft launch gates:
- p95 latency delta <= 180ms over baseline
- additional 5xxs <= +0.15%
- quality pass >= 94% on core eval prompts
- cost delta <= +10% token spend on sampled workload

diego (eng): Flag config sketch:
{"flag":"tenantpriority_v0","phases":[{"name":"dogfood","pct":1,"tenants":["internal-*"]},{"name":"pilot-region","pct":5,"tenants":["opt-in","eu-*"]},{"name":"rand-10","pct":10}] ,"fallback":{"on_latency":"route_legacy","on_error":"kill_flag"}}

zara (sre): Rollback triggers:
- p95 delta > 220ms sustained 10m -> rollback
- 5xx > baseline + 0.4% for 5m -> rollback
- per-tenant token spike > 4x baseline -> exclude tenant

lee (eng-ml): We'll ship a lightweight scoring job to compute sim-score and a dashboard indicator per tenant. If quantized quality < 0.9 sim for 3h, auto-switch that tenant to full-precision.

amy (sales): I'll get pilot signups and confirm rollback contacts. Need the pilot agreement draft.

mari (product): Action items:
- Product: pilot addendum + rollback template (mari)
- Eng: implement flag + slow-start enforcement + metric export (diego)
- SRE: dashboard + kill-switch + runbook (zara)
- Eng-ML: paired A/B logging + auto-promotion logic (lee)
- CS/Sales: recruit pilots + comms (rachel/amy)

deploy-bot: Canary plan created: tenantpriority_v0 phase=pilot pct=5 creator=mari start=1719012000

diego (eng): I'll open PR with flag stub and perf test today.

zara (sre): I'll draft the rollback runbook and automate the exclusion list.

amy (sales): Pilot tenants confirmed: atlas-eu, climber; will route agreements to mari.

mari (product): Thanks. Keep updates here. Aim to start pilot next Tue.
